title: One-step conditional branch
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a program, and $c,l,pos$ integers or natural numbers as appropriate, with $v$ an integer and $m$ a memory. Suppose the program at position $pos$ begins with the instruction that branches to $l$ when address $c$ contains a negative value, the word at $c$ represents $v$, and $v$ satisfies $-2^W \le 2v < 2^W$. Then one step from $(pos,m)$ leaves the memory unchanged and moves the program counter to $l$ if $v<0$, and to $pos+1$ otherwise.
